name: Flora and Sauna
source:
Flora and Sauna is an 18+ visual novel set at a spa with some unique services. Explore the spa and meet a fun cast of interesting characters! Help them out, and they'll be sure to reward you in their own special ways~

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1995420/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Flora and Sauna》是一部18岁以上的视觉小说，以水疗中心为背景，提供一些独特的服务。探索水疗中心并结识一群有趣的角色！帮助他们吧，他们一定会以自己独特的方式奖励你~

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1995420/]Steam[/url]]
